 Odisha govt hikes Dearness Allowance by 3 per cent 
 Odisha Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi has announced a three per cent increase in Dearness Allowance for employees. The DA has now increased from 60 per cent to 63 per cent, starting from July 1. PTI 
 Published On Nov 17, 2026 at 02:35 PM IST

 Odisha chief minister Mohan Charan Majhi Odisha Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi on Tuesday announced a three per cent hike in Dearness Allowance (DA) for state government employees. The DA for government employees has now increased from 60 per cent to 63 per cent. This will be effective retrospectively from July 1, and the increased DA will be paid in cash along with the salary for the month of November, a release issued by the Chief Minister's Office said. Additionally, the Dearness Relief for pensioners has also been increased by three per cent. Around 8.5 lakh Odisha government employees and pensioners will benefit from the raise, officials said.
